module.purpose: Defines shared TypeScript types and enums for the bookings feature package, providing the data contracts used by the booker UI, booking creation flows, and recurring bookings.
module.summary: This file centralizes TypeScript type definitions for Cal.com's bookings feature package. It derives PublicEvent from the viewer TRPC router's public event output and uses it as the basis for a constrained BookerEvent type that picks only the fields needed by the booking page. Helper types BookerEventUser and BookerEventProfile refine user/profile subsets. It also declares query-state shapes (BookerEventQuery), a generic ValidationErrors type for react-hook-form integration, a price-display EventPrice type, an EventDetailBlocks enum for orchestrating which UI blocks render, a re-export of BookingCreateBody, a RecurringBookingCreateBody extension with appsStatus and recurring metadata, an alias BookingResponse for RegularBookingCreateResult, and MarkNoShowResponse resolved from the handleMarkNoShow module. The file serves as the single source of truth for booking-related types consumed across booker components and booking submission handlers.
module.businessContext: These types govern Cal.com's scheduling surface — the public booking page and booking creation endpoints. Inconsistencies here would surface as runtime errors when users attempt to schedule, reschedule, or mark no-show, directly impacting the core scheduling product.
classes: PublicEvent (~L11-11): TRPC-derived public event type for booking page consumers
BookerEventQuery (~L13-18): Query-state wrapper shape around BookerEvent
BookerEventUser (~L20-28): Refined user subset with brand colors and bookerUrl
BookerEventProfile (~L30-30): Slim profile subset with name, image, layouts
Slots (~L33-33): Required non-nullable slot list from DatePicker props
BookerEvent (~L35-70): Bookable event shape with users and profile augmentation
ValidationErrors (~L72-72): Generic react-hook-form field-path error array
EventPrice (~L74-74): Price and currency tuple with alternate symbol flag
EventDetailBlocks (~L76-84): Enum ordering UI blocks like duration and price
BookingCreateBody (~L86-86): Re-exported booking creation request schema
RecurringBookingCreateBody (~L88-95): BookingCreateBody extended with recurring metadata
BookingResponse (~L98-98): Alias of RegularBookingCreateResult creation response

edgeCases.inputShape: Slots where DatePickerProps['slots'] is null or undefined
edgeCases.behavior: Slots type uses Required<NonNullable<...>> to force presence; consumers must handle undefined before use per the source comment.
metadata is explicitly typed as undefined (removed) on the user projection even though source PublicEvent may include it.
BookingResponse is an alias for RegularBookingCreateResult; source flags this as a known followup TODO.

assumptions.description: PublicEvent['subsetOfUsers'] is a non-empty array element type so Pick on number index works.
PublicEvent.profile and PublicEvent.subsetOfHosts are present and shaped as accessed.
react-hook-form exposes ErrorOption and FieldPath<T> generic types.
@calcom/prisma enums exports SchedulingType used by RecurringBookingCreateBody.
@calcom/trpc react exports RouterOutputs with viewer.public.event key.
@calcom/features/handleMarkNoShow default export has an awaited return type compatible with the inferred MarkNoShowResponse.
@calcom/features/bookings/lib/dto/types exports RegularBookingCreateResult compatible with BookingResponse consumers.

moduleContractTests.scenario: PublicEvent must mirror the viewer.public.event tRPC output
moduleContractTests.then: PublicEvent is exactly T with null/undefined stripped; BookerEvent is assignable from any successful fetch result
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins dependency on tRPC router shape so consumers can refactor confidently.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Slots must force consumers to handle the undefined-slots case
moduleContractTests.then: Slots is exactly T (no undefined) so consumers cannot silently ignore missing slots
moduleContractTests.rationale: Commented invariant: shifts undefined-handling responsibility to the consumer.

moduleContractTests.scenario: BookerEventQuery must encode mutually informative loading flags
given: A booking-page data fetch in flight
moduleContractTests.when: isPending === true || isError === true || isSuccess === true
moduleContractTests.then: Exactly one of the three flags is true; data is BookerEvent | null when isSuccess is true and undefined otherwise
moduleContractTests.rationale: Loading state is the most error-prone consumer contract; pins it explicitly.

moduleContractTests.scenario: ValidationErrors must be a flat array of (fieldPath, error) pairs
given: a react-hook-form form of generic type T extends object
moduleContractTests.then: each element has key: FieldPath<T> and error: ErrorOption; assignment with a non-FieldPath key is a type error
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guarantees form-error rendering keys stay within registered field paths.

moduleContractTests.scenario: BookingCreateBody from this barrel must equal the one from bookingCreateBodySchema
moduleContractTests.then: Both resolve to the SAME type identity (no duplicate declaration, no structural drift)
moduleContractTests.rationale: Barrel re-export must not fork the schema type.

moduleContractTests.scenario: RecurringBookingCreateBody must include every BookingCreateBody field plus recurrence extras
moduleContractTests.when: RecurringBookingCreateBody is assigned a value of type B
moduleContractTests.then: Compilation succeeds (B is a structural subtype); extras noEmail/recurringCount/appsStatus/allRecurringDates/currentRecurringIndex/schedulingType are all optional
moduleContractTests.rationale: Ensures recurrence calls reuse the single-booking contract surface.

given: RegularBookingCreateResult is the canonical create-booking response type
moduleContractTests.then: BookingResponse and RegularBookingCreateResult are interchangeable; renaming is the only difference
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the temporary dual-name pattern until the followup PR unifies them.

moduleContractTests.scenario: MarkNoShowResponse must track the handleMarkNoShow handler's resolved return shape
given: @calcom/features/handleMarkNoShow.default is an async function returning Promise<R>
moduleContractTests.then: MarkNoShowResponse === R and updates automatically when the handler's return type changes
moduleContractTests.rationale: Dynamic import keeps the type bound to the live handler — change there MUST propagate here.

moduleContractTests.scenario: EventPrice must require currency and price while leaving displayAlternateSymbol optional
moduleContractTests.then: Compilation succeeds; missing currency or price is a type error
moduleContractTests.rationale: Minimum-viable contract for any price rendering downstream.

moduleContractTests.scenario: EventDetailBlocks enum must enumerate the five rendering blocks
given: the booking details UI iterates over EventDetailBlocks
moduleContractTests.then: Exhaustiveness check passes only when DURATION, LOCATION, REQUIRES_CONFIRMATION, OCCURENCES, PRICE are all handled
moduleContractTests.rationale: Adding a block must force UI updates; enum-as-contract pins the count.
